LuoCoCo Cute Egg Separator, Ceramics Vomiting Chicken Egg Yolk White Separator

$7.99
This ceramic egg separator is shaped like a little chicken mid-vomit, which is either hilarious or horrifying depending on your sense of humor — but it works perfectly. You crack the egg into the chicken's mouth, and the whites drip out through the beak while the yolk stays inside. It's a genuinely clever design for anyone who bakes regularly and needs to separate eggs without getting shell fragments everywhere. The ceramic construction means it won't stain or hold odors like plastic ones do, and it's dishwasher safe. If you bake even semi-regularly, this is the kind of silly-but-functional gadget that makes kitchen tasks more fun.
